per_line.quality: 118 CSS rules organized into stable modular UI classes; media constraints elsewhere require separate exact line review. Layout uses max-width 730, grids and wrapping for mobile. No execution/performance testing by direct source read.
per_line.security_privacy_performance: No direct member-data reads in CSS. Potential under-44px tap targets (.icon-button 40px, .primary 43px, .text-button 32px, .compact 33px), severity-4/other color contrast, radar SVG labeling, overflow:clip masking focus outlines and transform without prefers-reduced-motion need measured mobile/accessibility/visual evidence, not labeled active defects.
per_line.dead_or_obsolete: Every selector is a candidate UI styling dependency; no caller-specific reachability fully traced, nothing proven safe to remove.
per_line.redundancy: Shared button variants and state modifiers intentionally reuse tokens; duplicate runtime style declarations not proven as wasted bytes.

current_counterpart.relation: Live stylesheet blob differs elsewhere but original physical line5 identical.

per_line.testability: Browser/390px and desktop Light/Dark, keyboard/screen reader, touch-target spacing, reduced-motion preference, computed CSS, overflow and SVG/contrast visual regression; no tests performed here.
per_line.improvement: Propose measured 44px target/contrast improvements only if actual live usability failure and safe alternative established; preserve Locked design and UI interactions.
per_line.locked_fit: Mobile-first clean Log Shot→Rate→Recommendation, readable coffee cards, stable History/Community and offline PWA controls, progressive disclosure, preserved theme.
per_line.reviewer: Direct AI source-level review of complete 9537-character physical CSS line and all 118 selector blocks, not human sign-off.

validation.source_method: Direct AI numbered semantic review, not independent human.

findings.description: Archived private GitHub Free no branch protection; Nov4-Nov30 owner public exception explicitly supersedes blanket historic visibility assumptions; #38 owns release guard.
Potential small target dimensions, CSS clipping/focus and sensory tone/keyboard/reduced motion need mobile visual/contrast proof. No active defect.

next.live_drift: All changed and newly added source requires separate direct semantic review; A33N3 machine snapshot never grants line credit.
